'''VZ-114''', also known as '''Rampart's Star Destroyer''', was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served within the [[Imperial Era|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]]. In [[19 BBY]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] was utilized as part of the Empire's [[Attack on Kamino|operations]] to seize control over the technological advancements of the [[Kaminoan]] [[species]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]]. Following the acquisition of the [[cloning]] technology and the [[Chief Medical Scientist]] [[Nala Se]], the [[Star Destroyer]] alongside two other Venators was ordered by Rampart to commence an [[aerial bombardment]] on the planetary [[capital]] of [[Tipoca City]] under instructions from [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. After the city's destruction with its submersion into Kamino's [[ocean]]s, the Vice Admiral ordered his and the two other Star Destroyers to rendezvous with the rest of the Imperial [[fleet]] located elsewhere.

==Description==
As a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Star Destroyer]] possessed two command [[Bridge (starship)|bridges]],<ref name="Return" /> each of which contained [[hyperwave comm scanner]]s, and was propelled by a series of eight [[Ion engine|ion drive]] [[Engine|thrusters]]<ref name="Equipment" /> located at the [[Starship|vessel's]] stern. One of the vessel's bridges provided its command crew with a 180-degree view of the surrounding space through a series of [[viewport]]s, while also possessing two separate pits for its crewmembers.<ref name="Return" /> In addition the bridge contained [[databank]]s which stored information, including the command log.<ref name="TC" />

The Star Destroyer was also equipped with a ventral [[hangar]] bay that contained a single [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]]. Along the [[warship]]'s exterior [[hull]],<ref name="Return" /> the Venator was also armed with four port and four starboard [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret]]s alongside two medium dual [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s, one located port and another located starboard.<ref name="Equipment" />

==History==
===Destruction of Tipoca City===
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref> following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganization]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], the Imperial government had begun to cede its cloning contracts with the ruling government of the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and its [[Prime Minister]], the [[Kaminoan]] [[Lama Su]], as a result of the costs necessary to produce [[clone trooper]]s for the reorganized [[Imperial Army]], which could be diverted towards the [[War-Mantle|training]] of [[Stormtrooper|conscripted soldiers]].<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref> Sometime later in that same [[Standard year|year]], the Empire established operations on Kamino in order to seize control of the Kaminoan [[species]]' [[cloning]] technology and essential medical personnel, along with the reassignment of the remaining clone troopers in the [[capital]] of [[Tipoca City]] away from the planet. Amid their operations on Kamino, led by Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]], the Empire positioned a force of three ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers in the planetary [[orbit]], while the rest of the fleet was stationed elsewhere.<ref name="Return" />

[[File:VenatorsDestroyTipocaCity-RtK.png|left|thumb|290x290px|VZ-114 and its accompanying Star Destroyers fire on Tipoca City]]
Not long after, with the withdrawal of all remaining essential personnel from the city alongside the acquisition of the cloning technology and the Kaminoan [[Chief Medical Scientist]] [[Nala Se]], Rampart informed Imperial Admiral [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] of their successful operations on Kamino. As a result, Tarkin instructed Rampart to commence an [[aerial bombardment]] on Tipoca City when the Star Destroyers were ready, prompting the Vice Admiral to order his fleet to move into firing position.<ref name="Return" />

===Attacked on Coruscant===
Months following the attack, which was covered up by the Empire as the result of a cataclysmic storm, the Venator returned to the [[Coruscant shipyard]] on the [[capital]] [[planet]] of [[Coruscant]] for repairs and maintenance. During the return trip, clone officer [[Slip (clone trooper)|Slip]] made a copy of the ship's command log for future use and stored it in the ship's backup [[databank]]s. Later, Slip and his fellow trooper [[Cade]] went to [[79's]], a [[cantina]] catering to off-duty clones, where Cade revealed that he had secretly messaged Rampart about his decision to reveal Tipoca City's destruction to the [[Imperial Senate]]. As the duo were leaving the bar, a [[Clone X trooper]] sent by Rampart, [[Clone X]] shot and killed Cade, although Slip managed to escape.<ref name="CC">{{TBB|The Clone Conspiracy}}</ref>

Frightened and enraged by the incident, Slip decided to go public with the reveal like Cade intended. To that end, he contacted [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] who had taken over as representative of the clones in the Senate during the voting of the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]]. Chuchi discussed Slip's claims with fellow Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] and agreed to help Slip testify; before he could be extracted by her guards though he too was killed by X who had caught up with them. Chuchi managed to escape thanks to Slip's contact, [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]].<ref name="CC" /> After hearing her story, Rex decided that the only way to prove Rampart's actions was to recover the command log copy Slip had made, and called the renegade [[Clone Force 99]] for help.<ref name="TC" />

[[File:Vz-114_destroyed.png|thumb|250x250px|VZ-114 lies in the bottom of the shipyard trench]]
[[Hunter]], the team leader, along with Rex and [[Echo]] who knew Coruscant's secret Lower Level passages, formulated an infiltration plan. They entered the shipyards through one such passage and climbed to the ship's [[hull]] after hijacking a [[droid]]-operated [[repulsor platform]]. They then made their way to the bridge after taking out the security detail still present on board, but [[Tech]] discovered that to access the databanks they had to reactivate the power in the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. In doing so, they made their presence known to shipyard personnel who dispatched a unit to check on the ship. The team was taken out by the Force, but not before one of them could notify shipyard security of the intruders. This resulted in a firefight both inside and outside the ship, as [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]] were also launched against the ship but taken down by [[Wrecker]] and Echo who hijacked the [[turbolaser]]s. To escape the shipyards, Echo activated the ship's [[Engine|thrusters]] which caused it to break through the structural supports holding it in place and to fall to the surface of the shipyard trench; the team then escaped using [[Republic escape pod|escape pods]] and left the facility through the lower level passages, leaving VZ-114 severely damaged.<ref name="TC" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer served under the command of Imperial Vice Admiral Rampart during the time of the Empire's operations on [[Kamino]]. In addition, the Star Destroyer was also operated by several [[clone navigation officer]]s, clone stormtroopers, and [[Imperial officer]]s.<ref name="Return" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rampart's ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer was introduced in "[[Return to Kamino]],"<ref name="Return" /> the fifteenth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' television series, which aired on [[August 6]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-august-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in August 2021}}</ref>
